questions.question: Why couldn't Mei Mei find the screen on the 2006 mission?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: Mei Mei asks them where the screen is, only to find out Gojo (who was in charge of it) never put it up in the first place.

questions.question: Why did Mei Mei exorcise more than her quota during the Night Parade?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: Mei Mei singlehandedly exorcised fifty curses in order to meet her quota. She would go on to exorcise more in order to earn a bonus.

questions.question: Why hadn't Maki been promoted despite how strong she is?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo fills her in on the fact that Maki's family is getting in the way of Maki's promotion.

questions.question: What did Mei Mei tell Aoi about accompanying Yuji on his mission?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: Mei Mei tells Aoi that the person who nominated a person can't accompany the nominee on missions much to his disappointment.

questions.question: What did Mei Mei do when Niji Ebina surrendered?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: As the enemy surrenders, Mei Mei asks what use can he be for her but kills him when he doesn't answer her right away.

questions.question: What did Mei Mei have done to her Japanese assets after fleeing to Kuala Lumpur?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: she calls an associate and asks them to sell off all of her Japanese assets, in view of the events that have unfolded

questions.question: Why did Mei Mei kill the head of the New Shadow Style clan?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: her brother is currently a victim of the leaders binding vow and proceeded to kill the clan head

questions.question: How did Kusakabe become the new head of New Shadow Style?
questions.subject: Mei Mei/Synopsis

answer.item: he himself became the new Head of New shadow style school due to her killing the former one
